metadata.name: HCC Risk Adjustment Test Suite
metadata.description: Example test cases for HCC risk adjustment evaluation

test_cases.clinical_note: A 70-year-old male with type 2 diabetes mellitus with chronic kidney disease stage 3 (eGFR 45). Current medications include metformin (held due to CKD) and insulin glargine. HbA1c 7.8%. Also has essential hypertension well-controlled on lisinopril.

A 68-year-old female with history of breast cancer status post mastectomy 2 years ago, currently on tamoxifen. Recent mammogram of remaining breast shows no abnormalities. Also has chronic heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF), ejection fraction 55%.

A 75-year-old male with severe COPD (GOLD stage 4), on home oxygen 2L/min continuous. Recent pulmonary function tests show FEV1 28% predicted. Also has peripheral vascular disease with claudication at 1 block.

A 62-year-old female with major depressive disorder, recurrent, severe, currently in partial remission on sertraline 100mg daily. Also has morbid obesity with BMI 42 and obstructive sleep apnea on CPAP therapy.

A 80-year-old male with end-stage renal disease on hemodialysis three times weekly via left arm AV fistula. Also has secondary hyperparathyroidism and renal anemia on epoetin alfa. Diabetes is the underlying cause of ESRD.
